# Adaptive integration pilot overview

The Adaptive Integration Pilot tests embedding mastery tracking and personalized pathways within existing K-12 learning platforms. It matters because seamless data flow reduces teacher workload and improves real-time intervention accuracy. Key terms include “learning node” (content units), “proficiency checkpoints,” and “dashboard sync.” Typically, the Product Manager for District Solutions leads the pilot, coordinating with engineering, curriculum specialists, and district tech coordinators to ensure alignment with procurement requirements and classroom realities. Success metrics focus on engagement uplift and teacher satisfaction.
